method: independent second check of every item, sentence, explain, gq, panel and teach field; accents and romanisation consistency checked by script; encyclopedia titles verified; give-away options rewritten

corrections.what: Greek sentence said 'Greece (Η Ελλάδα) has 24 letters'; now 'Το ελληνικό αλφάβητο έχει είκοσι τέσσερα γράμματα'
unnatural emphatic Εγώ πίνω νερό (contradicts pronoun-dropping lesson); now Πίνω λίγο νερό
Εγώ μένω εδώ replaced with natural pronoun-less sentence
kimámai (spelling-based) changed to pronunciation kimáme, matching the rest
'no infinitive' softened to 'no ordinary infinitive'
'dictionary list' wording corrected
romanisation ksé-ro -> kséro
'The article is repeated before the adjective' was wrong for ο μεγάλος δρόμος; corrected
question contained a stray Greek question mark after a greeting (Καλή μέρα;); now Καλή μέρα!
συγγραφέας romanisation fixed (singraféas)
awkward question wording clarified
'perfect-aspect' is the wrong term for aorist/perfective; corrected
karekopódhara missing 'l' and 'orexi' -> óreksi; fixed
typo paróllo -> parólo
garbled explanation ('να-form without να') replaced
'ποιος gives ποιότητα' misleading for learners (ποιος = who); replaced by σοβαρός/σοβαρότητα
polytonic εἰρωνεία in a monotonic course normalised; meaning of the original word added
